scope: The replayed stage contains the exact executed collector and all mathematical source. This index, the replay receipt, raw invocation/execution/runtime/result logs and the preserved preseal manifest are evidence added after replay; these additions are not claimed to have been replayed themselves. Every original source hash is retained; public copies alias only native machine locators. Raw startup rejection logs retain zero-method scope. No process arguments, versions, modes or output bytes are fabricated from a historical command template.
